Other features included entropion of the eyelid, syndactyly and clinodactyly of the fifth fingers.

Additional variable manifestations include vasculitis, lymphomatoid granulomatosis, aplastic anemia, and chronic gastritis. Occasionally, T-cell lymphoma may be observed. Laboratory findings include normal or increased activated T cells and reduced memory B cells.
